Tournament

    How to play

    You are the player at the bottom of the screen, hitting up the court. Your player runs to the ball on their own — your job is the shot.

    • •
      TapStandard drive into the open court.
    • ↑
      Flick up fastFlat power drive, deep and low.
    • ⇧
      Long slow drag upLob, high over their head.
    • ↓
      Swipe downDrop shot, dying just over the net.
    • ↔
      Swipe sidewaysAngled slice into the tramlines.

    Any swipe's sideways lean steers the ball left or right — swipe up and to the right to drive down the right-hand line.

    Timing

    A ring appears around your player when a ball is on the way. Swipe as it reaches you: strike it in the middle of the ring for a clean, accurate shot. Swipe early and it is buffered, so you can commit before the ball arrives.

    Serving

    Swipe up to serve; a longer, faster swipe means a bigger serve, and the sideways lean places it wide or down the T. Two serves, as usual — the second is automatically safer.

    Scoring

    Normal tennis. 15, 30, 40, deuce and advantage, six games to a set with a tiebreak at 6-6. Quick matches use a short set to four games.
